name: ai-game-development-pipeline
description: Evidence-driven AI game development lab and production pipeline by By JTT

scripts.validate: node tools/validate-repo.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const np='registry/ai-game-networking-systems.v1.json';const n=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(np));n.entries.find(e=>e.entry_id==='network.nakama').execution_status='EXECUTED';fs.writeFileSync(np,JSON.stringify(n,null,2));const ip='registry/ai-game-dev-registry.v1.json';const i=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(ip));i.shards.find(s=>s.shard_id==='networking').namespace='media';delete i.rules.executed_non_core_entries_require_completed_evidence;fs.writeFileSync(ip,JSON.stringify(i,null,2));" && node tools/validate-registry-shards.mjs && node tools/validate-github-config.mjs && npm run test:governor && npm run test:control-plane-freshness
